item.title: Version 0.20.0
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.20.0

What’s New

  • Recover Deleted Links from Trash: Deleted links now move to Trash, where you can restore them, empty it, or set a 7-to-90-day retention.
  • LibreWolf Support: SupaSidebar now works with LibreWolf, including live tabs, saving pages, and per-profile launching.
  • Close Firefox and Zen Tabs: Close live tabs in Firefox, Zen, and LibreWolf right from the sidebar, just like other browsers.

Improvements

  • Search Across All Spaces: Command panel search now finds saved links from every Space, not just the one you’re in.
  • Local and Custom AI Models: Connect to Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server, pick a model from a dropdown, and see live status.
  • Complete Translations: All 11 supported languages are now fully translated.

Performance

  • No Freeze on Large Collections: The command panel no longer freezes while saving links or rebuilding search across thousands of links.
  • Smoother Browser Tracking: Removed main-thread work while following browser tabs, cutting momentary stutters.

Bug Fixes

  • The sidebar now docks to the screen edge instead of stranding mid-screen when your browser leaves the Stage Manager stage.
  • Typing a saved link’s full name now reliably matches it, even when many similar results compete.
  • The first Enter now confirms an in-progress Japanese or other IME conversion instead of opening the top result.
  • Creating a folder from selected links now keeps your click order instead of scrambling it.
  • Shortcut key combinations now appear in every language instead of showing as a dash.
  • Appearance settings and license menus now appear in your language instead of English.
  • AI permission buttons no longer overflow the window in French, German, and other longer languages.
  • Yes/no toggles in Shortcuts and Command Panel settings now appear as switches instead of checkboxes.
  • The ⌘⌥1 through ⌘⌥0 pin shortcuts now release for other apps when Pinned Item Number Shortcuts is off.
  • Folder hover previews now consistently show about six links instead of varying each time.
